proof.pattern: (owner-sale check \((flat|partial)\): proven=|broker position is flat . handing to the external-close check|stop coverage unresolved \(.*\); state=PENDING_STOP_REPLACE saved=\w+ paged=)

expected_rate: event-driven: any long-term-hold sale outside the bot, or any stop-coverage problem on a long-term hold (several per week recently)
window_reason: Owner sales and stop-coverage problems are not daily; ten sessions covers the recent rate.
reversal: an auto-heal whose triggering sale was not the owner's; any API order seen with a null source; a long-term hold left holding shares with no protective stop after an owner sale; the same stop-coverage page sent twice in one ET day for one reason

metrics.name: repeated QHM stop-coverage pages per symbol per day
metrics.bound: at most one per (symbol, reason) per ET day

metrics.name: owner sales healed without a confirm command
metrics.bound: every proven app sale of a pure long-term hold

baseline_exempt_reason: The proof lines are new text emitted only by this change ("owner-sale check (flat|partial): proven=", "broker position is flat - handing to the external-close check", and the "paged=" suffix on the stop-coverage line); none appears in the production log before this ship.
